cards.claim: Yibing Maxine Tan spent four formative years at Lawrence University.
cards.quote: As the sun dipped behind the rolling hills of Appleton, Wisconsin, the campus of Lawrence University came alive with the sweet melodies of strings and woodwinds. It was a crisp autumn evening, and the air was filled with the promise of new beginnings. Among the sea of students hurrying to their evening classes, one figure stood out - Yibing Maxine Tan, her dark hair tied back in a neat ponytail, her eyes shining with an intensity that hinted at a mind always in motion. Maxine, as she preferred to be called, had always been drawn to the stars. As a child, she would spend hours gazing up at the night sky, dreaming of the day she could soar among the constellations. It was this passion that had led her to pursue a degree in aeronautics and astronautics at the University of Washington, where she had honed her skills and earned her Master's degree. But before that, Maxine had spent four formative years at Lawrence University, where she had discovered the beauty of music and the power of the human spirit.
